So even if it eventually encompasses the entire world, it would easily be avoided by driving under the speed limit or by removing cars from the picture. Also, in the description, it says it only appears at night—so things like curfews could be set up (as they already are). Finally, it doesn't prevent human population from recovering from the death toll it inflicts; it simply targets specific and random people to kill, and is not always successful in that too.

item.title: Speed limit
item.content:encoded:
SCP-973 will manifest at night when another vehicle enters the designated territory, and is believed to be triggered by the target vehicle accelerating over a certain speed. This limit varies, with the average being in the area of 88.5 km/h (55 mph), but it can range anywhere between 53.3 km/h (35 mph) and 112.7 km/h (70 mph).

Two things about that:

  1. What led the Foundation to think that breaking some speed limit is the trigger? If the entity said "Run, you [EXPLICATIVE] speeder", or each time it dumped the corpses it left a speeding ticket with them, that would make researchers think it was about speeding. But absent something like that, how would they know?
  2. Saying that the speed limit can vary from 35 mph to 70 mph seems to imply that going about 70 mph will always trigger the entity, which would make it a lot easier for the foundation to attempt to destroy it, since there'd be a guaranteed way of triggering it.
